scripts.sprites: python3 -I tools/clean_sprites.py art/processed/player reference=art/raw/player/01-reference.jpeg@px=5.6 idle=art/raw/player/02-idle.jpeg@px=5.6 walk=art/raw/player/03-walk.jpeg@px=5.6 shoot=art/raw/player/04-shoot.jpeg@px=5.6 hurt-death=art/raw/player/05-hurt-death.jpeg@px=5.6 && cp art/processed/player/idle.png art/processed/player/walk.png art/processed/player/shoot.png art/processed/player/hurt-death.png art/processed/player/player.json public/sprites/player/
scripts.enemies: python3 -I tools/extract_sprites.py art/processed/enemies 1-crawler=art/raw/enemies/1-crawler.jpeg@grid=6x3 1-spitter=art/raw/enemies/1-spitter.jpeg@px=5.8@grid=6x4 1-miner=art/raw/enemies/1-miner.jpeg@px=6.4@grid=6x3 1-drone=art/raw/enemies/1-drone.jpeg@grid=6x3 1-lurker=art/raw/enemies/1-lurker.jpeg@grid=6x3 1-bloater=art/raw/enemies/1-bloater.jpeg@grid=6x3 && for n in crawler spitter miner drone lurker bloater; do cp art/processed/enemies/1-$n-strip.png public/sprites/enemies/$n.png; done
scripts.boss: python3 -I tools/extract_sprites.py art/processed/bosses 1-brood-mother=art/raw/bosses/1-brood-mother.jpeg@grid=6x4 && mkdir -p public/sprites/bosses && cp art/processed/bosses/1-brood-mother-strip.png public/sprites/bosses/brood-mother.png
scripts.items: python3 -I tools/extract_sprites.py art/processed/items 1-items=art/raw/items/1-items.jpeg@grid=4x3 2-items=art/raw/items/2-items.jpeg@px=6@grid=4x4 overlay-1=art/raw/items/overlay-1.jpeg@grid=3x4 overlay-2=art/raw/items/overlay-2.jpeg@grid=3x4 overlay-3=art/raw/items/overlay-3.jpeg@grid=3x4 overlay-4=art/raw/items/overlay-4.jpeg@grid=3x4 overlay-5=art/raw/items/overlay-5.jpeg@grid=3x4 overlay-6=art/raw/items/overlay-6.jpeg@grid=3x4 overlay-7=art/raw/items/overlay-7.png@grid=3x2 && mkdir -p public/sprites/items && cp art/processed/items/1-items-strip.png public/sprites/items/items.png && cp art/processed/items/2-items-strip.png public/sprites/items/items2.png && for n in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7; do cp art/processed/items/overlay-$n-strip.png public/sprites/items/overlay-$n.png; done && python3 -I tools/overlay_boxes.py public/sprites/items/overlay-*.png && python3 -I tools/split_rows.py art/raw/items/coins.jpeg art/processed/items/split 4 coins:0:2 shop:2.72:3 && python3 -I tools/extract_sprites.py art/processed/items coins=art/processed/items/split/coins.png@px=10.5@grid=6x3 shop=art/processed/items/split/shop.png && cp art/processed/items/coins-strip.png public/sprites/items/coins.png && cp art/processed/items/shop/00.png public/sprites/items/terminal.png && cp art/processed/items/shop/01.png public/sprites/items/dispenser.png && cp art/processed/items/shop/02.png public/sprites/items/sign.png
